sources.description: GRACE-FO Level-1B day archive of 2020-01-01 without the LRI products (147 MB download), for testRealData's ACT1B, AHK1B, GNV1B, KBR1B and SCA1B rows. MAS1B and THR1B are NOT copied: their tests hard-code the bundled excerpts' lengths. ACH1B is in the .ACX archive and bundled, so it is not fetched.

sources.licenceText: ITSG (TU Graz) operational GRACE-FO kinematic orbit, served at ftp.tugraz.at. The server's README describes the products and states no licence.
sources.description: The full published day of the ITSG kinematic orbit (0.4 MB download, unpacked from .gz), for testItsgProducts/testFullDayKinematicJitter: the clock-driven departures from 10 s sampling occur only past the bundled 60-record excerpt.
